research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Apollo GraphQL is focused on developing infrastructure for composed supergraphs, graph linking, and live queries in graph routers. Their research includes systems to limit query handling and infrastructure for queryable supergraph subset representations. These efforts aim to enhance the efficiency and capability of unified graphs, facilitating better application development and user experiences.

overview_description.description: Apollo GraphQL helps developers build better software faster with a declarative, graph-based approach to API orchestration. With over 1 billion downloads of its open-source software, Apollo has become the standard for working with GraphQL and powers the most innovative brands today. The Apollo GraphOS® platform provides the infrastructure to unify APIs into a composable graph, enabling teams to query data from anywhere and ship new experiences with speed and confidence. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Insight Partners, Matrix Partners, and Trinity Ventures, Apollo is headquartered in San Francisco. Learn more at: https://www.apollographql.com.

about_short_description.short_description: Apollo GraphQL helps developers build better software with a declarative, graph-based approach to API orchestration.

product.name: Apollo GraphOS
product.description: A cloud-based API orchestration platform for building, governing, and operating federated GraphQL graphs that unify data from multiple services for web, mobile, and AI applications.

product.name: GraphOS Router
product.description: An enterprise GraphQL runtime that routes requests across federated subgraphs, with capabilities for performance optimization, security, caching, and observability.

product.name: Apollo Connectors
product.description: A declarative GraphQL orchestration capability for connecting REST APIs and other HTTP services to a GraphQL graph without building custom resolver integrations.

product.name: Apollo MCP Server
product.description: A server that exposes existing GraphQL operations as Model Context Protocol tools so compatible AI agents can discover and use GraphQL APIs.

product.name: GraphOS Studio
product.description: A browser-based GraphQL development and management environment for exploring operations, registering schemas, validating changes, and monitoring graph usage.

product.name: Apollo Client
product.description: A GraphQL client library for web, mobile, and other applications that fetches, manages, and caches data from GraphQL APIs.
